text: [issue by tcgqimingxc] ### Steps to Reproduce the Bug 1.open jei,look recipe(with water or other fluid) 2.The game crashes (leaving a crash report) when you click the X in the top right corner to close the game while in the JEI interface (inventory). use 19.42.0.385 and .384 neoforge21.1.238 1.21.1 ### Expected Behavior can see the fluid and not crash ### Actual Behavior i can't see the fluid when i close the game,game was broke .372 no this problem ### Mod Pack URL (Optional) _No response_ ### Mod Pack Version (Optional) _No response_ ### Extra Notes (Optional) ### latest.log _No response_ [comment by tcgqimingxc (none)] Sometimes, the names of some items are the same as other items (like the empty slot in the picture), and they don't have textures. [comment by V4LK0y (contributor)] Hey, i'm unable to recreate your bug, could you also provide the list of mods you are using. Thanks [comment by V4LK0y (contributor)] Would also help if you can share the crash report [comment by tcgqimingxc (none)] > Would also help if you can share the crash report [CSN_The Song Of The Sky已安装的资源信息.csv](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30540136/CSN_The.Song.Of.The.Sky.csv) [错误报告-07-30-2026_17.39.18.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30540431/-07-30-2026_17.39.18.zip) [comment by sme23 (none)] Encountered the same or similar issue with fluids not rendering in recipes with 19.42.0.385. Every 19.42.0 version of JEI has this same issue. It looks like it was addressed as #4394, but the problem still persists. [comment by tcgqimingxc (none)] > Hey, i'm unable to recreate your bug, could you also provide the list of mods you are using. > Thanks This problem has always been there since version .379 (including version .379) 自从.379版后（包括.379版）都会有这个问题 I hope to fix this problem in the next version (.386 version) 我希望能在下一个版本（.386版）修复这个问题 I don't know if this is a module conflict, so I will actively investigate this problem. 我不知道这是不是模组冲突了，所以我会积极排查这个问题 [comment by tcgqimingxc (none)] > Hey, i'm unable to recreate your bug, could you also provide the list of mods you are using. > Thanks 我检查了Create与Mek两个模组，与最新版JEI同时安装时出现这个问题 与其他的mod一同安装也是有这个问题，即使是干净安装 请尽快修复！！！pls！ I checked the two modules Create and Mek, and this problem occurred when installing the latest version of JEI at the same time. There is also a problem when installed with other mods, even if it is installed cleanly. Please fix it as soon as possible!!! Pls!
